title: Amigos para La Aventura
text: Amigos para la aventura (English language: Friends for the Adventure) is a 1978 Argentine comedy film directed by Palito Ortega and written by Víctor Sueiro.

title: Uragh Stone Circle
text: The Uragh Stone Circle is a neolithic stone circle near Gleninchaquin Park, Tuosist, County Kerry, Ireland.

title: Elisabeth Morrow School
text: The Elisabeth Morrow School is a private coeducational day school located in Englewood, New Jersey, United States, serving students age three through the grade eight.
